nodes.name: Log Discovery
nodes.notes: POST to pipeline tracking — logs each discovered story

nodes.name: Filter Agent (Claude)
nodes.notes: Claude scores relevance 0-1. Stories >= 0.6 proceed to writing.

nodes.name: Log Filtered Out
nodes.notes: Story didn't meet relevance threshold — log and stop

nodes.name: Fetch Source Page
nodes.notes: Fetches the full source article for the writer agent

nodes.name: Writer Agent (Claude)
nodes.notes: Claude writes the full article from source material

nodes.name: Editor Agent (Claude)
nodes.notes: Claude reviews, polishes, fact-checks the draft

nodes.name: Check Press Photos
nodes.notes: Checks press_photos table for a matching brand image before falling back to Unsplash

nodes.name: Unsplash Fallback
nodes.notes: Fallback: sources a cover image from Unsplash if no press photo found

nodes.name: Publish to Supabase
nodes.notes: Inserts the finished article via the publish API

nodes.name: Prepare Dedup
nodes.notes: Placeholder — full dedup via Supabase check can be added

meta.notes: Colonizer.space content pipeline: Scout (RSS) → Filter (Claude) → Write (Claude) → Edit (Claude) → Cover (Unsplash) → Publish (Supabase). Runs every 30 min. Requires env vars: PIPELINE_SECRET, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY, SUPABASE_URL.
